# The R Project for Statistical Computing

> > R is a free, open-source language and environment for statistical computing and graphics, maintained by the R Foundation and supported by a global community.

The R Project provides official resources for downloading and using R, documentation, community support, and information about the R Foundation's governance. R evolved from the S language developed at Bell Labs and is widely used for data analysis, statistical modeling, and reproducible research across academia and industry.

## Key Topics

- R language
- Statistical computing
- CRAN (Comprehensive R Archive Network)
- R Foundation
- Open source
- Package development
- R community
- Documentation
- Contributors
- Release management
- Bug reporting
- Mailing lists
- useR! conferences
- GNU project
- Platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux)

## Getting Started

- [R: The R Project for Statistical Computing](https://www.r-project.org): Official R homepage with downloads, getting started, and CRAN links
- [R: What is R?](https://www.r-project.org/about.html): Introduction to R language, history from Bell Labs S, and capabilities
- [R: Getting Help with R](https://www.r-project.org/help.html): Getting help with R using built-in functions and CRAN resources
- [CRAN: Frequently Asked Questions](https://cran.r-project.org/faqs.html): Platform-specific FAQs for R on Windows, macOS, and Linux

## Documentation & Reference

- [CRAN: Manuals](https://cran.r-project.org/manuals.html): Official R manuals covering installation, data import, and language
- [CRAN: Mirrors](https://cran.r-project.org/mirrors.html): Global CRAN mirror network for R package distribution

## Development & Contributing

- [R Contributor Site – R Contributor](https://contributor.r-project.org): Guide for contributing to base R development and patch workflows
- [R Developer Page](https://developer.R-project.org): R release plans, development schedule, and version roadmap
- [R: Contributors](https://www.r-project.org/contributors.html): Core team and acknowledgments for R development by Ihaka and Gentleman
- [R: Bug Reporting in R](https://www.r-project.org/bugs.html): Guidelines for reporting bugs and patches in R and CRAN packages
- [The R Blog](https://blog.r-project.org): Technical updates, bug fixes, and platform compatibility news

## Community & Support

- [R: Mailing Lists](https://www.r-project.org/mail.html): R community mailing lists for discussion and announcements
- [R: Conferences](https://www.r-project.org/conferences): useR! conference series and R community events

## R Foundation

- [R: The R Foundation](https://www.r-project.org/foundation): R Foundation mission, governance, and copyright administration
- [R: Membership Fees & Donations](https://www.r-project.org/foundation/donations.html): R Foundation membership and donation information

## Optional

- [R: What's New?](https://www.r-project.org/news.html): Release notes and changelog for R version updates
- [R: Board and Auditors](https://www.r-project.org/foundation/board.html): R Foundation board members and organizational structure
- [R: R Foundation Membership](https://www.r-project.org/foundation/members.html): R Foundation ordinary members and governance contributors
- [R: R Foundation Supporting Members & Donors](https://www.r-project.org/foundation/donors.html): List of R Foundation patrons and corporate supporting members
- [R: R Logo](https://www.r-project.org/logo): R Foundation logo downloads under CC-BY-SA and GPL licenses
